title: Career Roadmap — Airport Operations Controller
summary: Dataset ID: 703 Level: UG Category: Travel, Tourism, Hospitality & Transport Degree Pathway: Aviation & Aerospace Programmes – Air Traffic Management / Air Navigation Services Target Career: Airport Operations Controller Career Domain: Airport Operations, Airside Management, Safety, Coordination and Airport Emergency Response

blocks.text: An Airport Operations Controller monitors and coordinates airport activities to maintain safe, efficient and compliant airport operations. The role involves coordinating with airside teams, terminal operations, airlines, ground handlers, security personnel, maintenance teams and emergency services.

The exact responsibilities vary by airport and employer. An Airport Operations Controller is not automatically an Air Traffic Controller (ATC). ATC personnel manage aircraft movements within their assigned airspace and on manoeuvring areas under applicable ATC procedures, while airport operations personnel coordinate broader airport facilities, safety and operational activities.
Core responsibilities

items.text: Monitor airport operational status and service disruptions.
Coordinate airside inspections and operational checks.
Track runway, taxiway, apron and terminal restrictions.
Coordinate with airlines, ground handlers and airport departments.
Support emergency response and contingency procedures.
Coordinate operational notices and shift handovers.
Maintain incident reports and operational logs.
Support compliance with airport procedures and applicable regulations.
